scope: unfixed HIGH/CRITICAL vulnerabilities in the pinned Debian Trixie runtime image
rationale: Trivy reports no FixedVersion for the listed CVEs. Full scan output remains retained. The exception is time-limited and does not waive fixed vulnerabilities, MEDIUM findings, misconfigurations, runtime smoke tests, or non-root checks.
required_owner_review: Review each CVE, package reachability and compensating controls; record approval identity, timestamp and review reference before promotion.
approval_mechanism: Authenticated GitHub PR issue comment by spinlnw10-art, bound to exact source SHA, image config digest, full Trivy report SHA-256, and exact unfixed HIGH/CRITICAL CVE set. A checked-in JSON status is never accepted as approval.
medium_review_mechanism: Authenticated GitHub PR issue comment by an independent repository collaborator/member (not spinlnw10-art), bound to exact source SHA, image config digest, full Trivy report SHA-256, and exact unfixed MEDIUM CVE set; rationale and expiry are mandatory.
